metadata.description: Netdust harness plugins — core (cross-stack discipline, hooks, memory), wp (WordPress framework knowledge), statamic (Statamic 6 + Peak). Stack-agnostic core; layered WP + Statamic plugins.

plugins.name: netdust-core
plugins.description: Netdust business + ops + content core: the per-project memory convention (STATE/lessons/todo — live hooks in netdust-agent), content/marketing skills (brand-voice, marketing, market-research), the design-builder skill (measured-motion reference recreation), the research skill, ops/infra skills (ploi, secure-server, dev-stack — DDEV/branch-flow/.env), the 9-method /deploy dispatcher, /memory-audit + /pattern-miner knowledge commands, and the ploi MCP. NOT a coding harness — the build harness (gates, craft skills, reviewer agents, TDD/threat-model/shake-out, /integration + /shakeout) lives in netdust-agent. Stack-agnostic. Layered on by netdust-wp, netdust-statamic.

plugins.name: netdust-agent
plugins.description: Netdust overlay on superpowers — superpowers is the process workhorse (brainstorm, plan, TDD, review, finish); netdust-agent adds the gates: an intake router (class A–F priced by open decisions + a stakes dial), plan-time gates machine-checked by bin/gate-check.py (threat model, invariants, ground-truth, Source: per FR, deliverable-first ordering, behaviour clusters), build-time gates (tier-based testing through the netdust WP harness, review clusters with independent reviewers, feature tests by an independent test-author after each task group), and a self-contained machine layer (hooks + bin/ scripts, bare python3) that verifies artifacts instead of trusting testimony. 0.18 (the re-thinning): 27 skills cut to 6 thin overlays that actually invoke their superpowers base; verify-budget is telemetry, never a HALT; skills ship with evals; and an on-demand convergence gate (/converge) — the codebase read against specs/<feature>/ for what was promised but never built, gaps appended to tasks.md as a PROPOSED phase behind gate-check + the seam.

plugins.name: netdust-wp
plugins.description: Netdust WordPress plugin — WP discipline, WP planning (plan-requirements gate + golden-path slice), WP reference, ntdst-core framework + golden-path feature exemplars, WP commands. Layers on netdust-core.

plugins.name: netdust-statamic
plugins.description: Netdust Statamic plugin — Statamic 6 + Peak skills, build playbook, shake-out, scaffolding commands. Layers on netdust-core.

plugins.name: netdust-react
plugins.description: Netdust React plugin — Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind, packaged to iOS/Android with Capacitor. Skills: react-architecture (project shape, the gate wiring standards-gate/testing-workflow read, storage-durability rules — localStorage is not durable on iOS — and the web/native seam), capacitor-react (native feature access from React; vendored from capawesome-team/skills, MIT). Templates for the thin mechanical layer only: strict tsconfig, eslint with feature-boundary + persistence-convergence rules, prettier, lefthook, knip. Deliberately thin and grown from real builds rather than authored ahead of them. Layers on netdust-core and netdust-agent.
